note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: # owner signs in once, off camera: az login --allow-no-subscriptions
Push-Location src\FlowDeploy; dotnet build -nologo -v q; dotnet run --no-build -- ../flow/SendLoanReminder.clientdata.json; Pop-Location

Read-Host 'Owner: Solutions > Equipment Desk > Connection references: pick a Dataverse and an Office 365 Outlook connection for each new reference; then add the flow to Equipment Desk (phone) with the btnRemind block from LoansScreen.pa.yaml, save and publish; test loans: CT-0043 overdue for the borrower test user, one not overdue or returned. Press Enter'

screens.name: flow-designer
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk: SendLoanReminder and the two connection references
Show the PowerApps (V2) trigger (LoanId), Get loan, Today, Problem, Can remind (True: Send reminder, Respond sent, Respond send failed; False: Respond skipped), Respond not found
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: app-send
steps: Play 'Equipment Desk (phone)' in the phone preview > Open loans
Tap 'Send reminder' on the overdue CT-0043 row: 'Sending...' with the other buttons disabled, then green 'Reminder sent to alex.demo@contoso.com for CT-0043.'
Switch to Outlook on the web (https://outlook.office.com/) as the borrower test user: 'Please return CT-0043 Laptop 14'
Back in the app tap it on the not-overdue or returned loan: yellow 'No reminder sent: it isn't overdue yet.'
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay
the borrower mailbox address and the real mail domain in Outlook

screens.name: flow-run
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk > SendLoanReminder > 28-day run history
Open the successful run: Problem empty, True branch, Send reminder and Respond sent succeeded
Open the refused run: Problem says 'it isn't overdue yet', Respond skipped
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
real addresses in run inputs and outputs, connection names

screens.name: run-only-users
steps: After the terminal part: SendLoanReminder > Details > Run only users > Edit
Show Dataverse and Office 365 Outlook both as 'Provided by run-only user'
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: the flow stays for later episodes (or turn it off); delete reminder mails that show anything real; reset the test loans; az logout if signed in only for this.'
